note_en: 哪怕 means "even if, even though" and introduces a concession; the main clause usually has 也: 哪怕 A，也 B "even if A, still B." In the text: 哪怕收入少得可怜，他也舍不得停播 "even though his income was pitifully small, he couldn't bring himself to stop streaming." 哪怕 can also tack a short add-on to the end of a sentence: 未成年人请别刷礼物，哪怕一块钱也不行 "minors, please don't send gifts — not even one yuan."
